review.verdict: 97 average, never under 95, most damage in the raid on Majordomo
review.summary: Ten bosses at 95 or better: Magmadar, Gehennas, Majordomo and Ragnaros 99, and Majordomo was the top damage of the whole raid (16 Arcane Explosions into the adds). No deaths in either raid tonight. Annoyingly little to complain about, so the complaints are small.

good.title: Majordomo
good.text: 99 and the most damage in the raid, a personal best (92 before).

good.title: Ten for ten
good.text: Nothing under 95. Magmadar 99 is a personal best too (98).

good.title: Fire Protection on Ragnaros
good.text: The only person in the raid who drank one.

good.title: Consumables
good.text: Supreme Power, Greater Arcane, Frost Power and Mageblood on all ten pulls, 5.4 buffs a pull against 3.9 for the other DPS.

fix.title: Sulfuron
fix.text: Active 55% of the fight against 90% for the other DPS, 8 seconds without a cast from 0:05. Still a 96, which only shows what the rest of the fight was worth.

fix.title: Zanza and food
fix.text: On 7 of 10 pulls each. Three bosses with half your kit.

review.verdict: Eight MC bosses without a single world buff, then all seven came back for the last two
review.summary: You walked out of BWL with all seven world buffs and into Molten Core with none. Lucifron, Magmadar, Gehennas, Garr, Geddon, Shazzrah, Sulfuron, Golemagg: zero world buffs on every one of them, and an average of 83 to show for it. Then on the Lava Surger trash before Majordomo all seven came back in one go, and you promptly parsed 96 and 99. The buffs were there all along, they just weren't on you.

good.title: Ragnaros 99
good.text: Third highest damage in the raid, with the world buffs finally back on.

good.title: Faerie Fire
good.text: 77 Faerie Fire (Feral) casts and 3 Goblin Sapper Charges.

fix.title: Your world buffs sat out eight bosses
fix.text: No world buffs on any of the first eight boss pulls, then Fengus, Mol'dar, Rallying Cry, Warchief's, Zandalar, Songflower and Sayge's all appeared at once on the Lava Surger trash. Your parses on the first eight averaged 83; on the last two, 97. Whatever you were saving them for, it was the wrong two bosses.

fix.title: Gehennas 61 and Lucifron 73
fix.text: Your usual there is 92 and 96. On Gehennas you were on the Flamewakers and got hit by Fist of Ragnaros twice before your first Shred at 0:12, so some of that is the adds. On Lucifron you had 9 seconds without a swing from 0:09.

fix.title: Standing in things
fix.text: Three Inferno hits on Geddon, three Arcane Explosions on Shazzrah, three Lava Bursts on Ragnaros: at or under the raid's median every time. Perfectly average at not getting hit.

review.verdict: Tanked Majordomo to a 97, kicked a Dark Mending, and still no flask
review.summary: A 76 average against your usual 60, no deaths, and a 97 tanking Majordomo, the best tank parse of the raid. On Sulfuron you were one of only three people to interrupt a Dark Mending, on a night where Dark Mending healed the priests for 85k. Still no flask, and Ragnaros's Lava Burst found you four times.

good.title: Majordomo 97
good.text: Top tank of the raid on Majordomo, a personal best (90 before).

good.title: Dark Mending kicked
good.text: One of only three interrupts on Sulfuron's priests all fight.

fix.title: Lava Burst
fix.text: Four Lava Bursts for 4,392, tied for the most hits in the raid. Spread out from the people near you.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Giants, Mongoose, Greater Armor and Zanza on every pull, but no flask and no food: 4 buffs a pull against 5.6 for the other tanks. Two raids tonight without a flask.

50671.text: 97 tanking, top tank of the raid.

50672.text: Four Lava Burst hits, tied for the most.
